title: GeoQuads — Daily
spoiler: Think names, flags, capitals and neighbours.
help: Find the 4 hidden categories. Each has 4 unique items.

groups.name: Capital has the same name as the country
groups.fact: Luxembourg is the world's only remaining sovereign grand duchy.

groups.name: Flag features an animal
groups.fact: Bhutan's flag shows a Druk, the Thunder Dragon; the country's local name means "Land of the Thunder Dragon".

groups.name: Name hides another country
groups.fact: Nigeria is named after the Niger River, and Niger is its next-door neighbour.

groups.name: Exactly one land neighbour
groups.fact: Lesotho is completely surrounded by South Africa.
